observations: A large frontal face structure fills most of the black ground, built from stacked rectangular zones — brow, eye sockets, and a wide open lower jaw — outlined in heavy black with yellow infill.

The right eye socket contains a dense blue grid of parallel vertical lines inside a dark square frame; the left eye is a smaller rounded recess with a spiral curl at center, creating clear asymmetry between the two sides.
Loose lines in sky blue, magenta, red, and white arc across the black background and over the face, some forming repeating zigzag or wave bands, others trailing freely beyond the figure's edges.
reading: Against a flat black ground, a face built from hard rectangular blocks holds the frame with a wide tooth-filled jaw and mismatched eyes — one gridded, one coiled. The surrounding lines do not stay behind the figure; they cross it, loop past it, and press in from every edge. The rigid geometry of the face sits in tension with the loose arcing lines that refuse to stay in place, giving the image a quality that is both fixed and restless.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbors nnxyz nnotb #184 and nnxyz nnotb #186 share a face or figure as subject but differ sharply: #184 layers marks over a busy mid-tone ground, while #186 opens into warm ambient color around a full-body figure. #185 is the most stark, black-grounded work of the three.

connections.reason: Both center a large frontal face with a wide toothed jaw and zigzag line bands, but #184 layers marks over a busy mid-tone ground while #185 isolates the same structure against pure black, sharpening contrast.

nnxyz nifty faces #17 also builds a face from stacked rectangular blocks with dense internal line-fill, but its open teal ground and green-dominant palette produce a lighter effect than the black-grounded #185.
